Stream a DuckDB query in data-frame batches

Source: R/query_stream.R
rducks_query_stream.Rd

Opens a connection-bound query stream with explicit next_batch() and close() methods. This is an R-side streaming result/session API; it is not inferred from scalar UDF IPC behavior and does not use the R-backed SQL table function path.

Usage

rducks_query_stream(con, sql, batch_size = 1024L)

Arguments

con

A duckdb_connection.

sql

SQL query string.

batch_size

Default number of rows requested by next_batch().

Value

Object of class rducks_query_stream with next_batch(n = NULL), close(), is_closed(), schema, and prototype fields.

Details

next_batch() returns the next data-frame batch or NULL at end-of-stream. Returned batches carry the stream's inferred nanoarrow schema as the "rducks_nanoarrow_schema" attribute. close() clears the underlying DBI result; it is safe to call more than once. A finalizer also closes unclosed streams, and rducks_release(con) closes streams registered on that connection before detaching connection-local state.
